case_record_instructions: Source-only task: no solver cases exist. Reference rows were screened for internal consistency; the four inconsistent rows in Table 3-1/3-2 are retained below as source_failures rather than silently used.

ledger_template.missing_evidence: No per-switch conduction loss is published; no switch RMS current is published.
No Eon/Eoff, no drain-current waveform, no event current published. This is the term the approx. 37 W claim belongs to.
No gate-charge or gate-current measurement; only a 22 ohm resistor and a 5 A driver rating.
Diode type, parallel count and recovery energy are not published.
Bridge BR1 loss is only inside the whole-board Pin-Pout aggregate.
No DCR or winding loss published.
Core material/loss not published; only the 180 uH inductance.
RSENSE value not published in the retained PDF.
EMI filter loss not separated from the whole-board aggregate.
On-board bias (UCC28881) quiescent loss not separated.
Two 27 CFM / 2.64 W fans are present; fan power is outside the PFC input boundary and not reported in Table 3-1/3-2.

constraint_findings: TIDUBE1D Rev D publishes whole-board efficiency only; it exposes no per-device Eon/Eoff, event current, switch RMS, gate-current waveform or per-device loss.
The reference's measured bus is a boost follower from 337.2 V (150 VAC) to 406.2 V (275 VAC); a 400 V bus occurs only near 270 V line, never at 120 V.
The reference uses 2 parallel MOSFETs (Q1, Q6) on a shared heatsink; the maintained 37 W claim is a single-device partial loss.
The reference inductance (180 uH) numerically equals the model's effective inductance, but at 45 kHz vs the model's 129.107 kHz; this coincidence must not be mistaken for a matched case.

POUT printed 2.0102 W; VOUT*IOUT=2010.2 W. Decimal-field defect; excluded.
PIN printed 2.1985 W; VIN*IIN*PF=2198.0 W; POUT>PIN as printed. Decimal-field defect; excluded.
POUT printed equal to PINAC (2687.4 W); VOUT*IOUT=2640.9 W. Excluded.
P=VI*PF identity not satisfied; the table fields are mutually inconsistent at these rows. Excluded.
Schematic and BOM are external downloads at TIDA-00779 and are not in the retained PDF; parallel connection and per-device sharing cannot be confirmed from the retained bytes.

next_discriminating_observation: One measured per-switch switching-transition capture on the boost MOSFET (or the parallel pair as a whole) with simultaneous drain current and Vds on a stated time base at a stated line phase, load and junction temperature, yielding turn-on and turn-off event currents and Eon/Eoff. Until such bytes exist for the exact device/driver/bias/point, the switching-energy claim stays unvalidated and the reference is architecture/whole-board evidence only.
